name: glyphs-mcp
description: Edit Glyphs fonts through a shared MCP App or conversation, with explicit saving and guarded recovery.

interface.shortDescription: Review and control open Glyphs fonts from ChatGPT and Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connect to the Glyphs 4 server for bounded reads and supported font edits. One standard MCP App offers saving, preparation and review where the host supports it; every action also works in conversation. Save and continue saves existing work once. The resulting edit remains unsaved until separately authorized. Native Undo/Redo and guarded job discard remain available.
defaultPrompt: Show the Glyphs MCP server identity and open-document status.
Read an exact glyph or layer and explain the evidence.
Preview an explicit spacing change without saving.
